title: Tabs
summary: Two to five panes of prose or figures behind one row of tabs. In print and in Markdown every pane is stacked under its label.
belongs: An arch card body that has a request path, a rollout and a failure mode to show in the same space.

default.description: index of the pane open on load

tabs.label: Request path
tabs.md: The producer commits the job, the dispatcher wakes a parked long-poll, the worker takes a lease.

tabs.label: Rollout
tabs.md: Shadow reads first, then one tenant, then the fleet.

tabs.label: Failure modes
tabs.md: A lease expires and the job returns to the head of its queue.
